tw-wi-manitowoc-koci-cellar-pot-1897.st: A second paper, the Two Rivers Chronicle, reported the find the same month and expected it to 'be the cause of some litigation'. In Nov 1897 Judge Anderson upheld the ante-nuptial contract, so the second wife took nothing; Koci died intestate and his only child, Mrs. John Reindl, was heir to the pot of gold found buried in the cellar.

set.tovw: Lead grade F: the pot was found and removed by the family in Jan 1897 (two local papers plus the probate contest, which the daughter won in Nov 1897); nothing reported left.
